title: Q-INSIGHT-a9eae49fb0: external pull on /pilot
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation insight --settled a9eae49fb0
**Status:** closed

Analytics loop finding (external_pull): outside readers are arriving at `/pilot` (491 outside-referred views of 1408 in 7 days). Source: first-party cookieless hits, no opt-in gate.

Give the page a clear next step (a related page, the interview, the pilot path) and one sentence for a reader who arrived from elsewhere; then find where they come from (the referrer column of the hits) and make that source easier to follow.

Prediction: `/pilot` keeps at least 50 percent of 1408 views over the 7 days after this item is filed.

This item closes when the finding settles (8 days): the measured outcome is written to ops/insight/findings.json, and the loop tunes its threshold from it.

size: M
